text_block_list.text:
With a great showing at the Satsuki Sho
under her
belt, Эйсин Флэш eagerly sets
her sights on the
Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, her difference in reputation to
the
other racers hasn't changed. To
remedy this, she
comes up with a plan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She wants to build experience by
running weekly
scrimmages that
replicate the intensity of the
Derby, but
the burden on her body would be

enormous.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thus, it falls on me to find a less taxing
way for
her to obtain the firsthand
experience she seeks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
